prompt: Two friends are sharing a pizza and there is exactly one slice left. Both are still hungry. Which plan is fairest?

options.text: Whoever grabs it first keeps it
Cut the slice in half so each friend gets some
Throw the slice away so nobody has it

explanation: Splitting the last slice shares what is left equally, so neither friend misses out — fair division means everyone gets a fair share.
